content: Human-labeling session — build-power-online-first:hard seed 1. Objective: Start with a Construction Yard, no power, and no economy. Build AND PLACE a Power Plant, then build and place an Ore Refinery, within about 32 turns on a tight $1750 budget. The Refinery requires a Power Plant first. The grid must actually be ONLINE — gross provided power must be ≥100, so the powr must be PLACED. Your Construction Yard sits in the north or south band depending on seed — read its position from the observation and place buildings adjacent to it.
